description.en: Original Capinatator-inspired slender continuous flexible marine body with two opposed arrays of modest curved head spines. Calm static pose and rounded economical spine tips, no enlarged fangs or predation action. Source microscopic counts simplified, no Yale artwork or external model copied; no precise locomotion claim.
description.zh: 原创Capinatator启发细长连续柔躯海生形态，头端两侧相对克制弧棘阵列。友善静态姿势与省简钝尖，无夸张獠牙或捕食动作；微棘数量省简，不复制Yale艺术图或外部模型，不承诺精确运动机制。
